metadata.title: EF-REG-023 - External task completion conflict prevents duplicate app decision
titlePath: EF-REG-023 - External task completion conflict prevents duplicate app decision

payload.script: const body=document.body.innerText; const key='EFREG023-ExternalComplete-EFQA-20260924T1400'; const hits=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('article,section,[class*="card"]')).filter(e=>(e.innerText||'').includes(key)); const card=hits[0]||null; return {href:location.href,queueText:(body.match(/\d+ expenses waiting on[^\n]*/)||[])[0]||null,cardCount:hits.length,cardText:card?(card.innerText||'').trim():null,taskOccurrences:(body.match(/101647510/g)||[]).length,openHref:card?Array.from(card.querySelectorAll('a')).map(a=>a.href).find(h=>h.includes('/expenses/'))||null:null};

payload.elementDescription: The blue 'Approve' button at the BOTTOM of the far-right EF-REG-023 approval card, directly below its red Reject and white Request rework buttons. The card is labeled EXP-1030 and EFREG023-ExternalComplete-EFQA-20260924T1400, with Task #101647510 above; this is not the blue Approve button on the adjacent EXP-1039 card.

payload.script: const body=document.body.innerText; const key='EFREG023-ExternalComplete-EFQA-20260924T1400'; const cards=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('article,section,[class*="card"]')).map(e=>(e.innerText||'').trim()).filter(t=>t.includes(key)); return {href:location.href,queue:(body.match(/\d+ expenses waiting on[^\n]*/)||[])[0]||null,cardCount:cards.length,taskCount:(body.match(/101647510/g)||[]).length,expenseCount:(body.match(/EXP-1030/g)||[]).length,cardText:cards[0]||null};
